quests.title: The Gate's price
quests.text: Beat The Last Wheel and clear the boss rush. The Gate stays shut until both are done.

quests.title: The keystones
quests.text: The Gate takes 16 keystones, one for each system of the world. Sneak-use the Gate with an item to give it; some are known to it already. Use the Gate bare-handed to see what is missing.

quests.title: The hold
quests.text: Hold the Gate for 120 seconds against the waves. Do not leave it.
